status: Shared list queue and lease state machine qualified; production list Wasm adapter not yet connected

contracts.implementation: One private generic queue core; base and list facades capture their exact canonical validator
contracts.delivery: Bounded synchronous FIFO, non-recursive reentrancy, immutable snapshots, private active-plus-pending capacity
contracts.failure: Executor/observer throws or thenables produce terminal uncertainty; no automatic head retry; disposal clears quarantine
contracts.lease: Exact executor plus captured mode, non-overridable private-state port, one-use settlement even on invalid requests, exclusivity through observers
contracts.staleness: Queue executor remains responsible for current owner/render/epoch; stale queued work is rejected before mutation
contracts.legacy: Base requests and cross-mode ports reject; borrowed facade methods cannot replace admission

verification.browserScope: List request captured from native DOM selection, reentrant FIFO delivery with stale epoch rejection, mode-bound lease exclusivity and single-use settlement; retains separate real Wasm bootstrap/recovery/DOM scenarios
developmentCorrections: Test typecheck required explicit generic result types for mocked async/union executors and an explicit undefined observer return.

remaining: Shared list Wasm command adapter and owner/controller integration
evidenceBoundary: Queue state-machine executor, not production list Wasm dispatch or native editing. No broad historical WebKit resolution claim.
